note: Which term of a member's position on a bill (legislature MemberPosition) is said as their reason when the player asks for their vote, and the fact key it sets (reason-<key>): the term weighing most against the bill is the one said (brief O; the Words lead's rule 93: "Why?" gets a reason on record). Lines that need a reason name the fact in requiresFacts.
heldReasonsSaidNote: The reasons a committee chair gives for holding a bill that the scene-talk bank has a line for (hearing-ask, reply refuse, requiresFacts reason-<key>). A chair whose strongest recorded reason has no line gives the next that has one; with none the chair stalls and then says the answer is given. hold-chair-sought.test.ts checks this list against the bank.
